# A kill is evidence for exactly as long as the test that reached it is
# untouched. Everything else in the suite can move without disturbing it.
#
# So the run records which tests failed against each mutant, and the next run
# reuses a kill unless one of those tests changed. A miss is the other way
# round: it needs the whole suite to pass, so anything added or edited could
# have closed it.
#
# Two templates, two tests, one test per template.

muxt test-template-mutations --seed 1 -v
cmp stdout want-first.txt

# Nothing changed: both stand.
muxt test-template-mutations --seed 1 -v
cmp stdout want-both-reused.txt

# Editing the farewell test unsettles only the mutant its test caught.
cp farewell-changed.txt farewell_test.go
muxt test-template-mutations --seed 1 -v
cmp stdout want-one-retried.txt

-- go.mod --
module server

go 1.24
-- templates.gohtml --
{{define "greeting"}}Hello, {{.Name}}!{{end}}
{{define "farewell"}}Bye, {{.Name}}.{{end}}
-- template.go --
package server

import (
	"embed"
	"html/template"
	"io"
)

//go:embed *.gohtml
var templateFiles embed.FS

var templates = template.Must(template.ParseFS(templateFiles, "*.gohtml"))

type Page struct {
	Name string
}

func Greet(w io.Writer, page Page) error {
	return templates.ExecuteTemplate(w, "greeting", page)
}

func Farewell(w io.Writer, page Page) error {
	return templates.ExecuteTemplate(w, "farewell", page)
}
-- greeting_test.go --
package server

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestGreet(t *testing.T) {
	var buf strings.Builder
	if err := Greet(&buf, Page{Name: "World"}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if got, want := buf.String(), "Hello, World!"; got != want {
		t.Errorf("greeting = %q, want %q", got, want)
	}
}
-- farewell_test.go --
package server

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestFarewell(t *testing.T) {
	var buf strings.Builder
	if err := Farewell(&buf, Page{Name: "World"}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if got, want := buf.String(), "Bye, World."; got != want {
		t.Errorf("farewell = %q, want %q", got, want)
	}
}
-- farewell-changed.txt --
package server

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestFarewell(t *testing.T) {
	var buf strings.Builder
	if err := Farewell(&buf, Page{Name: "Ada"}); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if got, want := buf.String(), "Bye, Ada."; got != want {
		t.Errorf("farewell = %q, want %q", got, want)
	}
}
